value of this attribute is `2`.

For example, if the promotion is a "Buy 2 shirts get 1 free", the value
of this attribute is `1`.

- `buyget` indicates that a promotion is a "Buy X get Y" promotion.

- `active` promotion is available for user to consume
- `inactive` promotion is no longer available to the user
- `draft` promotion is currently being prepared

For example, if the promotion is a "Buy 2 shirts get 1 free", the
value of this attribute is `2`.

children.name: apply_to_quantity

The quantity that results from matching the `buyget` promotion's condition.
For example, if the promotion is a "Buy 2 shirts get 1 free", the value
of this attribute is `1`.

value of this attribute is `2`.

children.name: apply_to_quantity
children.description:
The quantity that results from matching the `buyget` promotion's condition.
For example, if the promotion is a "Buy 2 shirts get 1 free", the value
of this attribute is `1`.

items.title: createOrderEditShippingMethodValidationStep
items.description:
This step validates that a shipping method can be created for an order edit.
If the order is canceled or the order change is not active, the step will throw an error.

:::note

You can retrieve an order and order change details using [Query](https://docs.medusajs.com/learn/fundamentals/module-links/query),
or [useQueryGraphStep](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/references/medusa-workflows/steps/useQueryGraphStep).

:::

items.title: createOrderEditShippingMethodWorkflow
items.description: Create a shipping method for an order edit.

items.title: orderEditAddNewItemValidationStep

This step validates that new items can be added to an order edit.
If the order is canceled or the order change is not active, the step will throw an error.

:::note

:::

items.description: Update or remove an existing order item's quantity in the order's edit.

items.title: removeOrderEditItemActionValidationStep
items.description:
This step validates that an item that was added in the order edit can be removed
from the order edit. If the order is canceled or the order change is not active,
the step will throw an error.

:::note

You can retrieve an order and order change details using [Query](https://docs.medusajs.com/learn/fundamentals/module-links/query),

:::

items.title: removeOrderEditShippingMethodValidationStep
items.description:
This step validates that a shipping method can be removed from an order edit.
If the order change is not active, the shipping method isn't in the exchange,
or the action doesn't add a shipping method, the step will throw an error.

:::note

You can retrieve an order change details using [Query](https://docs.medusajs.com/learn/fundamentals/module-links/query),

items.description:

items.description:

If the order is canceled, the order change is not active,

items.title: beginReceiveReturnValidationStep
items.description:
This step validates that a return can be received.
If the order or return is canceled, the step will throw an error.

:::note

You can retrieve an order and return details using [Query](https://docs.medusajs.com/learn/fundamentals/module-links/query),
or [useQueryGraphStep](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/references/medusa-workflows/steps/useQueryGraphStep).

:::

items.title: createCompleteReturnValidationStep
items.description:
This step validates that a return can be created and completed for an order.
If the order is canceled, the items do not exist in the order,
the return reasons are invalid, or the refund amount is greater than the order total,
the step will throw an error.

:::note

You can retrieve an order details using [Query](https://docs.medusajs.com/learn/fundamentals/module-links/query),
or [useQueryGraphStep](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/references/medusa-workflows/steps/useQueryGraphStep).

:::

items.title: acceptOrderTransferValidationStep
items.description:
This step validates that an order transfer can be accepted. If the
order doesn't have an existing transfer request, the step throws an error.

:::note

You can retrieve an order and order change details using [Query](https://docs.medusajs.com/learn/fundamentals/module-links/query),
or [useQueryGraphStep](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/references/medusa-workflows/steps/useQueryGraphStep).

:::

items.title: acceptOrderTransferWorkflow
items.description: Accept an order transfer request.

items.title: cancelTransferOrderRequestValidationStep
items.description:
This step validates that a requested order transfer can be canceled.
If the customer canceling the order transfer isn't the one that requested the transfer,
the step throws an error. Admin users can cancel any order transfer.

:::note

You can retrieve an order and order change details using [Query](https://docs.medusajs.com/learn/fundamentals/module-links/query),
or [useQueryGraphStep](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/references/medusa-workflows/steps/useQueryGraphStep).

:::

items.title: cancelOrderTransferRequestWorkflow
items.description: Cancel an order transfer request.

items.title: declineTransferOrderRequestValidationStep
items.description:
This step validates that a requested order transfer can be declineed.
If the provided token doesn't match the token of the transfer request,
the step throws an error.

:::note

You can retrieve an order and order change details using [Query](https://docs.medusajs.com/learn/fundamentals/module-links/query),
or [useQueryGraphStep](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/references/medusa-workflows/steps/useQueryGraphStep).

:::

items.title: declineOrderTransferRequestWorkflow
items.description: Decline a requested order transfer.

items.title: requestOrderTransferValidationStep
items.description:
This step validates that an order transfer can be requested. If the customer
is a guest customer, or the order already belongs to a registered customer,
the step throws an error.

:::note

You can retrieve an order and customer details using [Query](https://docs.medusajs.com/learn/fundamentals/module-links/query),
or [useQueryGraphStep](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/references/medusa-workflows/steps/useQueryGraphStep).

:::

items.title: updateOrderValidationStep
items.description:
This step validates that an order can be updated with provided input. If the order is cancelled,
the email is invalid, or the country code is being changed in the shipping or billing addresses, the step will throw an error.

:::note

You can retrieve an order's details using [Query](https://docs.medusajs.com/learn/fundamentals/module-links/query),
or [useQueryGraphStep](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/references/medusa-workflows/steps/useQueryGraphStep).

:::
